name: mb-web-monorepo
description: Mount & Blade-like web game monorepo (server, client, shared)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mb/shared && npm run build -w @mb/server && npm run build -w @mb/client
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @mb/server & npm run dev -w @mb/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mb/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mb/server && npm run typecheck -w @mb/client
